log_level.description: Logging verbosity (e.g., DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL)

bind_host.description: Network interface IP or hostname to bind to

bind_port.description: TCP port for incoming worker connections

rate_limit.description: Maximum requests per second (0 = no limit); helps prevent abuse

max_ttl.description: Maximum allowed TTL in seconds (enforced upper bound)

default_ttl.description: Default TTL (in seconds) applied when not specified

database_connection.description: Database connection string (e.g., PostgreSQL or MySQL URI)

connection_recycle_time.description: Time (seconds) after which DB connections are recycled

pool_size.description: Maximum number of database connections in the pool

pool_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for acquiring a DB connection

transport_url.description: Message broker connection string (e.g., RabbitMQ or Redis)

rpc_topic.description: Topic used for inter-service RPC communication

rpc_workers.description: Number of worker threads handling incoming RPC messages

service_worker_enabled.description: Set to false to disable the worker service

zone_types.description: List of zone types (e.g., public, private) this worker processes

exclude_tenants.description: List of tenant IDs to exclude from processing (empty = process all)

max_records_per_zone.description: Maximum DNS records allowed per zone (enforcement limit)

max_transfers_per_cycle.description: Maximum concurrent zone transfers processed per worker cycle

background_maintenance.description: Enable/disable background tasks like cleanup and consistency checks

id.description: Unique pool identifier (used in section header)

driver.description: Pool driver type (e.g., bind9, pdns, nsd)

host.description: Host IP/hostname for the DNS server

port.description: API port for DNS control interface

targets.description: List of backend DNS targets (servers) managed by this pool

pools.description: List of DNS server pools (each pool defines nameservers and backend targets)
